declared_before: the M1/M2 closeout re-execution of 2026-11-20; no value here was derived from an observed difference
tolerance_source: phase5 validation package tolerances already used for layer A on 2026-11-19 (suggested_abs 1e-8, suggested_rel 1e-10)
class_rule: the class of every cell must be identical on both sides; TEXT cells must be equal strings; FINITE cells must pass the finite_numeric test
schema_rule: column names and column order identical
key_rule: keys unique on each side and the key sets equal in both directions

ledgers.raw_hash: SHA-256 of the decompressed ledger CSV, recomputed by the control step (never taken from the program's own claim)
ledgers.strong_evidence: ledger sets equal in both directions AND every raw hash equal to the reference index
ledgers.row_path: otherwise every ledger is read from the designated reference ledger set (references/phase5_strategy_v1/<input sha256>/) and compared row by row: same schema, keys [signal_date] unique, same row order, cell rule above

acceptance: PASS only when every required layer is PASS; a missing reference makes the result INCOMPLETE (not accepted), never PASS
